title: Chapter 3: Scum, Bunnies, and Master 1
content: The long-awaited holiday had arrived. On this day, just before Golden Week, there were already several figures in my living room, even though the clock still showed morning hours.
“Kazu-kun, how do I look? Am I cute enough?”
“Perfect. Setsuna right now is insanely cute. I guarantee it.”
“Hehe, yay♪ I’m so happy♪”
When I nodded, Setsuna jumped up and down with a beaming smile. At the same time, the bunny ears on her head bobbed lightly, and the fluffy tail on her behind swayed gently.
Seeing that, I couldn’t help but smile too.
“Hmm. Truly wonderful. A perfect bunny girl who wouldn’t be embarrassing to show anywhere.”
What Setsuna was wearing now was a black bunny suit.
A high-leg leather outfit that exposed her shoulders, black bunny ears, and cuffs. A bow tie and fishnet tights—the classic image of a proper bunny girl that everyone imagines.
The combination of black hair and a black bunny suit was a standard but unbeatable pairing—and that’s exactly why it was so great.
The black bunny suit contrasted beautifully with Setsuna’s white skin, creating an exquisite balance.
The outfit clearly showed off her body’s curves, and Setsuna’s figure was outstanding. Her slender waist was clearly visible, which only enhanced her allure to the point of being almost shameless.
Her hair was tied in a ponytail, so the nape of her neck and her neckline were clearly visible, which was another plus.
The bow tie at her neck worked as an accent perfectly, emphasizing the gentle curve of her shoulders.
She looked healthy yet undeniably sexy, and the deep cleavage was quite provocative. Not that it matters, but I have always liked big breasts.
“Well, bunny girls are normally pretty embarrassing to wear…”
As I nodded, deeply moved by the growth of my childhood friend, a voice came from behind.
When I turned around, there was another childhood friend standing there, arms crossed with an exasperated look, dressed in a white bunny girl outfit.
“Oh, Arisa, you finished changing too?”
“Yeah, well… but this is my first time wearing a bunny girl outfit, and it’s got way more exposure than I thought. My shoulders feel kind of chilly.”
Arisa lightly flicked the bunny ears headband with her finger, looking somewhat displeased.
Her semi-long silver-blonde hair in a bunny suit gave off a different charm from Setsuna’s long hair.
Girls are strange creatures—just a change in hairstyle can make such a difference in impression. I was almost impressed.
Still, why does just having bunny ears make them seem sexier than usual?
Her outfit was a white bunny suit to match, but unlike Setsuna, her legs were covered in regular tights, highlighting her leg lines.
The outfit really brought out Arisa’s foreign-blooded figure. Just standing there, she had an outstanding presence and could easily work as a model.
It was also good news for me that her chest had grown even larger than Setsuna’s.
“Marvelous. The best. Perfect, I’d say. My eyes never fail me. Blue suits silver hair so well…”
I thought the silver hair and white bunny suit were a perfect match, but this exceeded my expectations.
Satisfied that my judgment was right, I nodded repeatedly, making Arisa blush.
“So, are you going to take pictures too? Honestly, I’m a bit embarrassed to show my bunny girl outfit to classmates…”
“No, bunny girls are my hobby. The social game I’m into lately is all about bunny girls. I’m not planning to show it to anyone in class, so don’t worry.”
Bunny suits are great. Add idols to the mix, and it’s unbeatable. I was just curious to see my childhood friends in bunny outfits, but I’m definitely not at fault.
“That’s your hobby?!”
“Yeah! Then I’ll prepare a full bunny outfit for myself! Kazu-kun, I’m always welcome!”
Arisa teased me for my hobby, while Setsuna happily accepted it.
Their contrasting reactions, combined with Arisa’s earlier words, somehow reminded me of old times.
Come to think of it, when I said I wanted to be supported, their reactions were pretty much like this.
Even though the situation is different in many ways now, it still makes me feel nostalgic.

“Hahaha. Well, it’s fine. You like what you like. Also, Setsuna, you don’t have to buy the bunny outfit. Ijuuin gave us all the colors for free. If you want, she said she’ll send additional options later.”
When I handed over the list of requests from classmates, Ijuuin immediately reacted to the added bunny girl outfits.

She launched into a ridiculously long rant: “You intend to make Setsuna-sama and Arisa-sama wear such indecent outfits!? How wonderful… no, actually, you’re the worst scumbag! I can’t forgive you, but reluctantly! Reluctantly, I will prepare them for you! Don’t say a word! Knowing a man like you, you’ll probably ask for every color and variation, right!? I understand, I understand, so I will prepare everything! Ugh, the thought of those two becoming bunny girls…! My nose is bleeding… ugh!”
And then she sent the outfits along with the others.

Not only were all the color variations and optional items included in full sets, but the suits themselves were all made of genuine leather, high-end products. Seriously, how much effort did she put into this?
Maybe Setsuna and Arisa felt it too, because while standing side by side in their bunny suits, they nodded in admiration at my story.
“Wow, that’s the Ijuuin zaibatsu heiress for you.”
“Come to think of it, the other outfits felt nice to the touch, and the materials were all high quality. The waitress outfit we just tried on was all silk.”
“The decorations were super elaborate too. That probably cost over a hundred thousand yen easily. Where did she even get them…?”
Even though we received them, I’m not sure if those can still be called waitress outfits.
Since these photos are only for classmates, I thought polyester costumes from a cheap cosplay shop would be enough.

But apparently, no mistakes can be made with outfits for the Damenzu. All were custom-made from high-quality materials, and she got them all in such a short time. What kind of connections did she use? That heiress is apparently more hardcore than I thought.
“Are you both ready?”
A small voice suddenly cut into the conversation between us, who were feeling the clear gap between the money and effort spent and our commoner status.
Turning around as if pulled, there was a girl dressed in a blue bunny outfit with a head dress and bunny ears inserted, wearing an apron and expressionless.
“Oh, Ichinose. Sorry to keep you waiting.”
“No, it’s natural that it takes time for women to change. Please don’t worry about me. This is part of the job.”
Ichinose said respectfully, but her body was anything but reserved.
I hadn’t noticed when she wore her uniform, but she had an ideal female figure—curves where they should be, and flat where they should be.
Frills reminiscent of a maid outfit adorned various parts, giving a somewhat youthful feel, while the garter belt covering from her thighs down added a seductive touch.
It was an oddly unbalanced but miraculously perfect coexistence of cuteness and sexiness—a wonderful bunny outfit.
(I always thought maid bunnies were heresy… but wow, this is totally acceptable…)
I found myself admiring her figure as I stared.
Since she comes to school dressed as a maid, I assumed she was a proud, hardcore maid, so this was a pleasant surprise—a little like a gift.
(This means I have to get Ijuuin to wear a bunny outfit as thanks. But still, Ichinose having something like this on hand…)
Compared to my two childhood friends, she was slender, but it would be unfair to compare her to professional idols.
Besides, good style isn’t the only charm a girl has.
Maids are popular among guys, and Ichinose’s doll-like, expressionless but perfectly formed face surely attracts many. It’s all about where you find the charm.
Just the fact that a maid can stand alongside two popular idols without looking inferior is impressive enough.
I think if polished, she could become an idol too, but unfortunately, she already has an employer.
(No matter how weak her loyalty is, if Ijuuin is around, she won’t support me.)
Feeling a bit of regret about that, I heard some excited voices.
“Ichinose-san is so cute! The bunny outfit really suits you!”
“I agree. But you didn’t have to go out of your way to wear a bunny suit, right? They didn’t tell you to cosplay, did they?”
“Well, yes, but since everyone else was changing, I thought it wouldn’t be right if I didn’t do anything.”
“Oh, sorry. Did I make you feel pressured?”
“No, not at all. Once I tried it on, it wasn’t so bad… Besides, it seems Kuzuhara-sama likes this outfit.”
“Huh, then I guess it’s fine.”
“…Ichinose-san, are you curious about Kazu-kun’s preferences? Why?”
“That’s a no comment. I’m still trying to figure it out myself.”
Before I knew it, the three of them were chatting happily.
That was good, but for me, the important thing was that these beautiful girls in colorful bunny outfits were lined up right in front of me.
(What a wonderful sight… bunny girls really are the best.)
I was deeply moved just by that, but having two idols and an idol-level beauty in my living room was even better.
It made me feel like I was a chosen one, and I got sentimental.
“Yeah, yeah. Having girls cosplay at your own house and making a harem. This is a man’s dream.”
By the way, my parents are currently both on overseas transfers, so I’m home alone.
Otherwise, I couldn’t have held this cosplay photoshoot. My parents are hardly lenient with me, their only son—they’re actually pretty strict.

When the transfer was decided, I was hoping for the classic gal game scenario where the son is left home alone while the parents go abroad, but my parents didn’t do anything so convenient for a high school boy.
“If we left you alone at home, you wouldn’t do anything good. We’ll definitely take you with us!” they said, desperately trying to separate me from my childhood friends.

My mom even said with a demon’s face, “I can’t let those good kids’ lives be warped because of a worthless son like you!” and tried to forcibly wrap me up while I was asleep and take me overseas. Thinking back on it still makes me angry.
Of course, I resisted with all my might, and after escaping, I ran to Setsuna and Arisa’s houses, begging them to convince my parents.
The way my parents looked at me then wasn’t as a proud son with childhood friends desperately trying to keep me, but as a hopeless scumbag.
Truly lamentable. I’m a super capable son who has figured out how to be a lifelong NEET without needing my parents’ help.
I don’t hate my parents, but I can’t accept being brainwashed into thinking working is the norm.
And they don’t even question that norm.
Thinking about my parents only strengthened my already firm resolve.
(I won’t become like them… I absolutely won’t work!)
Yes, I will live my life happily playing around.
For my ideal happy life, Setsuna and Arisa need to keep working hard as idols.
Their earnings are my lifeline and my key.
(If I can avoid working, I won’t spare any effort. I’ll build and maintain a harem if I have to!)
With that vow in my heart, I spoke to the three still chatting.
“Hey, you three, can I have a moment?”
“Hm? What? Oh, are we starting the shoot soon?”
Arisa asked as she turned around, and I smiled wryly, shaking my head lightly.
“That’s part of it… but I just realized I haven’t properly thanked you yet.”
I bowed my head as I spoke. There’s a saying about showing sincerity even among close friends, so I had to show my earnestness at a time like this.
“Thanks, both of you, for taking the time today even though you’re busy with work. Ichinose too. Thanks to all of you, I was really helped. I appreciate it.”
“It’s no problem. I don’t mind at all, and if I could help you, Kazu-kun, I’m actually happy!”
“I don’t mind either. Actually, I was glad you relied on me, Kazu… don’t make me say more, idiot!”
“As for me, it’s work, so don’t worry about it. Rather, it was a good chance to get to know Kuzuhara-sama better, so I should be the one thanking you.”
Each of them replied in their own way, but all were kind words.
Satisfied with that, I spoke again.
“Thanks. I’m glad you said that, but I’m a guy too. It’s a bit much to always be taken care of by girls, so let me thank you properly sometimes.”
“Thank you?”
“Yeah. Setsuna, Arisa, is there anything you want me to do? If so, tell me. I can’t say I’ll do anything and everything, but I’ll try my best.”
As soon as I finished speaking, the expressions of my childhood friends changed rapidly.
“No way, really?”
“Is that okay!?”
“Of course. You always give me pocket money, and I’ve wanted to do something for you too.”
Though there’s a bit of calculation in wanting to please them, this was definitely sincere.
Being a student and an idol must be stressful.
I don’t want my childhood friends to collapse, and if I can help them refresh, all the better.
“Well then, I guess I’ll go first…”
“Yay! I have something I want to ask Kazu-kun!”
While Arisa looked thoughtful, Setsuna was the first to raise her hand and appeal, her face full of a bright smile.
“That’s pretty fast. Have you had something you wanted to ask me for a while, Setsuna?”
“Hehe, yeah. I’ve been thinking I’d ask if I ever got the chance.”
“Oh, really?”
That wasn’t so surprising.
Even though Setsuna is a devoted good girl, it’s normal for her to have one or two things she wants.
I know she’s not a saint, but maybe I should be happy that my childhood friend actually has a wish.
“Ugh, she beat me to it…”
“Sorry, Arisa, you’re next. Don’t worry, I’ll listen properly.”
“Okay…”
Arisa slumped her shoulders beside Setsuna, but this kind of thing is first come, first served.
I gave a light word of encouragement to the downcast Arisa and turned back to Setsuna.
“Alright, Setsuna, tell me your wish. I’ll grant you one wish, no matter what.”
“Haha. That line sounds familiar from somewhere.”
Setsuna laughed at my joke, looking happy. I could feel a warm atmosphere flowing between us.
